name: Article 18, § 8 – 202
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 8. The Commission shall strengthen cooperation on training, capacity building, uptake of research and innovation results, and shall promote the sharing of knowledge and experience, between the Knowledge Network and international organisations and third countries in particular in order to contribute to strengthening the global health infrastructure and global ability to act and meeting international commitments, particularly those in the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030 and other relevant United Nations frameworks as well as crisis-specific instruments, such as the International Health Regulations. The Knowledge Network shall promote reciprocal, knowledge-based partnerships, and ensure the active participation of local actors and community-based organisations in order to contribute to context-specific, sustainable and inclusive capacity-building, while strengthening disaster risk management systems in partner countries.
